checks: connecting is silent; completed connected local action plays exactly once
incomplete, disconnected, uninitiated and nil-executor completions stay silent
NPC and player-like remote replicas never trigger this PC audio
cancelled connection has no disconnect announcement
default disconnection is silent and rapid reconnect cannot overlap
different devices share cooldown and unrelated exits cannot clear active device
clip duration safety exceeds short configured cooldown
optional disconnect plays once only for an established local device
disable and zero-volume settings are silent; disabling stops active sound
malformed settings default safely and numeric inputs clamp
missing audio, invalid duration and playback errors cannot escape game observers
transient audio failure does not consume cooldown or prevent later preview
no local player and invalid device identity stay silent
detach, attach and local-player replacement clear stale device state and stop audio
backward wall-clock movement does not bypass cooldown
settings reload preserves runtime controls and does not mutate gameplay methods
shuffle cycles cover every recording and never repeat at cycle boundaries
unavailable recordings are skipped and a single available recording remains usable
complete audio failure preserves the next selection and does not consume a shuffle position
pool validation removes duplicates and rejects unsafe or missing definitions without synthetic fallback
stop targets the actual randomly chosen event and clip-specific durations prevent overlap
playback errors skip broken clips without trapping the remaining shuffle bag
CET panel is overlay-only, can be hidden, and balances closed windows
panel controls apply safely and persist only after explicit Save
panel preview and sound list reload use the public audio pool without filesystem writes
settings persistence failures are contained and never touch unrelated files
panel errors cannot escape callbacks and an opened ImGui window is ended
manual preview queues through pause and overlay, then runs once on resume without time changes
queued previews expire or clear on reset/disable, with no delayed sounds
preview retains native Duration and Play errors and reports failure outcomes
diagnostic is read-only and reports version, duration, pause, player and requested rate
unknown pause state keeps manual preview queued until safely resumed
unpaused co-op menus still hold queued previews until the Audioware menu state clears
tracked playback preserves local owner and settings without duplicate Ext playback
menu entry after connection resumes only this addon handle and never creates another sound
menu entry before connection is covered after the new tracked event is queued
expired disabled detached replaced and shutdown handles cannot be resumed by later menus
resume failures remain contained and do not fall back to global audio or alter time
missing tracked API or menu hook falls back to Ext without killing the newly queued repeated clip
runtime tracked creation and queue failures stay errors rather than duplicating through Ext

boost is clamped to 0 through 24dB and malformed or nonfinite values use zero
boost never unmutes zero volume or disabled notifications
